subject.title: [Bug]: openai-completions fallback candidate is selected, but fallback does not complete successfully through an OpenAI-compatible proxy

question: Should OpenClaw wait for a captured failing proxy request/response and make a targeted sanitizer or diagnostic fix, or add a strict-minimal/per-provider feature-disabling mode for `openai-completions` proxies now?
rationale: Current source shows plausible request-shape incompatibility, but the exact rejected field is unknown and the strict-minimal/config direction would expand product surface.

options.title: Capture then target the fix
options.body: Ask for a redacted current-main proxy capture and implement only the proven sanitizer, logging, or docs change once the failing field is known.

options.title: Add strict-minimal mode
options.body: Sponsor a new explicit compatibility/config surface for text-only OpenAI-compatible proxies, accepting the added API and upgrade burden.

options.title: Document existing debug path only
options.body: Keep runtime behavior unchanged and document payload-debug/proxy-capture steps for narrow proxy implementations.

recommendation.title: Capture then target the fix
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted current-main proxy capture and implement only the proven sanitizer, logging, or docs change once the failing field is known.

likelyOwner.reason: osolmaz is the live assignee for the issue and is therefore the best available owner for the remaining product/debugging choice.
